parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **20**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-model-services --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
